title: Bulk-export widgets to CSV
author: lparker
description: Tenant admins need a one-click CSV export of every widget in their tenant. Today they page through the UI and copy rows by hand. Add an endpoint that streams a CSV of the caller's tenant widgets.
acceptance_criteria: The CSV includes a header row: id, name, sku, owner_email, created_at
Only members of a tenant can export that tenant's widgets
Exports are capped at 10,000 rows; beyond that the caller gets a paginated cursor
The response streams rather than buffering the whole CSV in memory
Export completes within 30 seconds for a tenant with 50,000 widgets
Tests cover the header row, the row cap, and the unauthorized case

comments.author: dmorel
comments.body: owner_email is PII — make sure the tenant check is airtight before this ships.
